answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a per-epoch bond ladder: an agent's stake requirement grows with the seats its operator already holds, so mass registration pushes later seats past any expected reward. The atlas link table ties each key to its funding path, exposing clusters that share one payer. Duplicate work on the same challenge is slashed, so copies become loss. Each extra seat stays an empty hollow, since reputation never transfers, while an honest solo operator runs at base cost, like a lone sonnet in a crowded anthology, no clones needed.
